context_manifest.patch_state: uncommitted working tree changes prepared for independent EvidenceGate review

migrations: No historical capability or PlanIR contracts were overwritten.
Added new v1alpha1 runtime capability request, grant and audit record schemas/examples.
Added RuntimeCapabilityRequest and RuntimeCapabilityGrant package-root aliases to avoid replacing PlanIR CapabilityRequest and CapabilityGrant exports.

acceptance_map.criterion: No request can compile into a grant broader than Goal/Policy scope.
Planner and verifier roles receive no filesystem write grant by default.
Executor writes outside allowed globs and commands outside allowlists are blocked before execution.
Every allowed and denied side effect emits an audit record linked to plan, node and policy decision.
Unsupported high-risk capabilities pause/fail closed rather than silently downgrade.
Security tests cover path traversal, symlink escape where applicable, command substitution, stale grant, role mismatch, spawn limit and approval absence.

known_limitations: The local profile is a reference monitor at the AHRA gateway API boundary; it is not OS, container, VM, network or host-wide isolation.
The local gateway cannot contain code that bypasses LocalRuntimeGateway.
No production secret broker, remote sandbox or irreversible external action support was implemented.
The symlink escape test is present but skipped on this workstation because Windows denied symlink creation with WinError 1314.
The producer does not mark TASK-0027 completed; independent verifier and EvidenceGate decide completion.
